title: Send a college question and receive a response
description: This verifies that a student can open the chat on the home page, ask a college-related question, and see an AI answer in the conversation thread.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the chat interface
Fill in a college-related question in the message field
Send the message
Verify an assistant response is displayed
Verify the conversation history remains visible

title: Continue a conversation with a follow-up question
description: This verifies that a returning student can ask a follow-up question and see the assistant respond within the same conversation thread with prior messages preserved.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the chat interface
Fill in an initial college-related question in the message field
Send the message
Fill in a follow-up question in the message field
Send the message
Verify the conversation includes both user messages and assistant replies
Verify the follow-up answer appears in the same chat thread

title: Show a loading indicator while waiting for a reply
description: This verifies that a prospective student sees the chat indicate it is working after sending a question and before the assistant reply appears.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the chat interface
Fill in a college-related question in the message field
Send the message
Verify a loading indicator is displayed
Verify an assistant response is displayed in the same conversation

title: Reopen the chat and review prior messages
description: This verifies that a student can close and reopen the chat drawer from the home page and still review the existing conversation history.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the chat interface
Fill in a college-related question in the message field
Send the message
Close the chat interface
Reopen the chat interface
Verify previous conversation messages are still visible
Verify the message input is available for a new question

title: Keep the conversation visible after a new response
description: This verifies that a student can send a question and still see the full thread, including the latest reply, without losing earlier context in the drawer.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the chat interface
Fill in a college-related question in the message field
Send the message
Verify prior user and assistant messages are visible in the conversation area
Verify the latest assistant reply is visible

title: Prevent sending an empty message
description: This verifies that a student cannot submit an empty chat message and the conversation does not add a new message.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the chat interface
Send the message without entering text
Verify a validation message is displayed
Verify no new conversation message is added

title: Handle rapid double send attempts safely
description: This verifies that a student who sends the same question twice quickly does not break the chat experience or create an obviously duplicated submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the chat interface
Fill in a college-related question in the message field
Submit the message twice in quick succession
Verify the conversation remains usable after the rapid send attempt
Verify the assistant response appears only once for the submitted question

title: Recover gracefully from a malformed assistant reply
description: This verifies that the chat interface continues to display a usable conversation when the assistant response content is unexpected or malformed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the chat interface
Fill in a college-related question in the message field
Send the message
Verify the conversation remains visible and usable
Verify a response area is displayed for the assistant message
